Title: Triage an alert
Pre-conditions: Alerts present in the Alert Queue
Post-conditions: Alert is closed or escalated; audit log row created; AIFeedback row created
ION surfaces: /alerts, alert detail modal, Bob verdict panel, Entity Timeline sidebar

Title: Create a case from one or more alerts
Pre-conditions: One or more alerts open in the queue
Post-conditions: Case is open; alerts bound; Workbench seeded; background tasks running

Title: Hand over the shift
Pre-conditions: Open cases, recent alerts, ongoing tunings
Post-conditions: Handover persisted; accessible to incoming shift

Title: Investigate a case
Pre-conditions: Case open and assigned (or assignable)
Post-conditions: Case closed or escalated_to_l3; Workbench ledger has full pin history; audit logs complete
ION surfaces: /cases/{id} (full surface), Workbench tab, Similar Cases sidebar, Entity Timeline drawer

Title: Escalate to L3 (deep-dive / forensics)
Pre-conditions: Case requires forensic depth (memory, full timeline, multi-host pivot)
Post-conditions: ForensicCase created and linked; AlertCase under_forensics_review

Title: Run a forensic investigation
Pre-conditions: ForensicCase open and assigned
Post-conditions: ForensicCase closed; chain of custody intact and queryable; AlertCase notified
ION surfaces: /forensics/{id}, Workbench tab, Custody Log tab, Timeline tab

Title: Hunt by hypothesis
Pre-conditions: Threat Intelligence indicating a hypothesis worth testing
Post-conditions: Hypothesis tested; coverage gaps documented; cases opened where warranted

Title: Build an attack story
Pre-conditions: Multiple correlated alerts
Post-conditions: Attack story persisted; reportable

Title: Tune a noisy rule
Pre-conditions: AIFeedback shows a rule with high FP closure rate
Post-conditions: Rule updated in TIDE; tuning proposal closed; metrics track post-tuning effect

Title: Map TIDE rules to a compliance framework
Pre-conditions: TIDE rules synced; framework target identified
Post-conditions: Compliance posture report ready; gaps catalogued

Title: Manage Bob's prompt templates
Pre-conditions: Bob enabled; templates exist or need creation
Post-conditions: Bob behaviour updated; eval harness re-runs in background

Title: Daily standup briefing
Pre-conditions: Shift just ended
Post-conditions: Daily action register updated; team aligned for the day

Title: Review analyst efficiency
Pre-conditions: >= 1 sprint of activity recorded
Post-conditions: Coaching plan recorded; learning paths assigned where needed

Title: Generate an executive briefing
Pre-conditions: Period of activity to summarise
Post-conditions: Executive briefing ready for leadership read-out

Title: Configure an integration
Pre-conditions: Integration endpoint reachable; credentials available
Post-conditions: Integration live; surfaces that consume it become active

Title: Manage users + roles
Pre-conditions: RBAC schema seeded
Post-conditions: User can log in with the assigned permissions

Title: Review audit log
Pre-conditions: audit:read permission
Post-conditions: Compliance has evidence; no data modified

Title: Tamper-evidence audit (Workbench)
Pre-conditions: Workbench used; ledger rows exist
Post-conditions: Ledger integrity attested or tamper alarm raised

Title: Complete a curriculum module
Pre-conditions: Course assigned (or self-enrolled)
Post-conditions: Curriculum progress tracked; certificate or badge if applicable

Title: Assign training to a team member
Pre-conditions: Learner identified
Post-conditions: Assignment persisted; deadline tracked

Title: Respond to a SAR
Pre-conditions: SAR received from data subject
Post-conditions: SAR-ready data extracted; UK GDPR Art. 15 obligation met

Title: Process an Erasure request
Pre-conditions: Erasure validated as legal under UK GDPR Art. 17
Post-conditions: Personal identifiers removed; operational artefacts retained as anonymised

Title: Generate the daily threat briefing
Pre-conditions: OpenCTI integration enabled; threat data current
Post-conditions: Daily briefing distributed; visible in /briefing next shift

Title: Actor deep-dive + coverage gap
Pre-conditions: Actor of interest identified
Post-conditions: Coverage gap registered; tuning proposal filed if applicable

Title: Deploy a new ION instance
Pre-conditions: Customer infrastructure provisioned; secrets in customer secrets-management
Post-conditions: ION operational; monitoring picks up health; first login works

Title: DR drill: restore from backup
Pre-conditions: Postgres backup <= 24h old; image artefact accessible
Post-conditions: Service restored; DR drill evidence captured for _mod_iteap.md S5

Title: Investigate a slow-query alarm
Pre-conditions: Customer monitoring fired on slow-query log row
Post-conditions: Root cause documented; tuning applied; alarm cleared

Title: Ask Bob about ION's data
Pre-conditions: Ollama enabled; AI chat surface accessible
Post-conditions: Question answered with provenance; conversation persisted per user

Title: Natural-language to Elasticsearch query
Pre-conditions: ES Security adapter configured; Ollama enabled
Post-conditions: Query executed; saved-search optionally created

Title: Review log source health before tuning a noisy rule
Pre-conditions: Log Source Health page populated
Post-conditions: Root cause clarified; ticket filed against source not rule

Title: Run an emulation plan
Pre-conditions: Emulation plan selected; permission to run in customer environment
Post-conditions: Detection coverage measured; gaps tracked for closure

Title: Tripped canary token
Pre-conditions: Canary tokens deployed; tripped event captured
Post-conditions: Canary-trip handled with high-fidelity response

Title: Forward case-create to customer ITSM
Pre-conditions: Webhook URL configured; HMAC secret set
Post-conditions: Customer ITSM has the ticket; delivery is auditable
